What is CCF?

DOWNLOAD RESULTS

The coverage of this request could not be established.

Credit conversion factor. The proportion of an undrawn commitment assumed to be drawn by the time a borrower defaults. It is what turns a limit into an exposure at default: EAD is the drawn balance plus the CCF applied to the undrawn part. Exposure and EAD are therefore different numbers, and this demo keeps them in separate fields.
